gloss: reluctant to part; sad to say goodbye

definitions.gloss: reluctant to part; sad to say goodbye; hating to leave
definitions.explanation: Describes the feeling of not wanting to separate from someone or leave a place because the time together has been so pleasant or meaningful.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れ{惜|お}しい{気持|きも}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧いっぱいだった。
examples.english: I was full of reluctance to say goodbye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あっという{間|ま}→あっという間：10426_attoiuma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{別|わか}れ{惜|お}しかった。
examples.english: The fun time flew by, and I was sad to part.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学先|りゅうがくさき}→留学先：09976_ryuugakusaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{惜|お}しくて→惜しい：10243_oshii⟧、⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I was so reluctant to part from my friends from my time studying abroad that tears came at the airport.

notes:
A compound adjective formed from ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧ (parting) + ⟦{惜|お}しい→惜しい：10243_oshii⟧ (regrettable, reluctant to lose). Expresses the bittersweet feeling of not wanting a pleasant time or relationship to end.

FORMS:
- {別|わか}れ{惜|お}しい: predicate (parting is sad)
- {別|わか}れ{惜|お}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in a way that shows reluctance to part
- ⟦{別|わか}れ→別れ：03788_wakare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{惜|お}しい→惜しい：10243_oshii⟧: separated form with the same meaning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別|わか}れ{惜|お}しい{気持|きも}ち: feelings of reluctance to part
- {別|わか}れ{惜|お}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to wave reluctantly in farewell
- ⟦{名残|なごり}{惜|お}しい→名残惜しい：10910_nagorioshii⟧: a near-synonym meaning reluctant to part (more literary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名残|なごり}{惜|お}しい→名残惜しい：10910_nagorioshii⟧: reluctant to part — very similar but slightly more literary; can also apply to leaving a place or ending an experience
- ⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧: lonely, sad — broader emotion of loneliness, not specifically tied to parting
- ⟦{切|せつ}ない→切ない：06167_setsunai⟧: painfully tender — a deeper, more wrenching emotional pain
